rule: Sensitive cryptographic buffers must be zeroized with wipememory or gcry_free before freeing
notes: Overwrites memory before deallocation

rule: Automated regression test suite must execute and pass via make check in tests/
notes: Comprehensive test suite covering gpg, gpg-agent, and smartcard daemon

rule: Patches are submitted to gnupg-devel@gnupg.org mailing list or dev.gnupg.org Phabricator
notes: Reviewed by core authors before commit

rule: Core GnuPG suite is licensed under GNU General Public License v3 or later (GPL-3.0-or-later)
notes: Standard GNU copyleft licensing

rule: Official release tarballs are cryptographically signed using designated GnuPG release key
notes: Maintains cryptographically authenticated release integrity

rule: Build system relies on GNU Autotools and C89 with select C99 features
notes: Wide portability across Unix and Windows platforms

rule: Go code formatting is strictly enforced with gofmt
notes: Enforced across all Go packages in repository

rule: Non-ASCII and bidirectional characters are prohibited by asciicheck and bidichk
notes: Protects against unicode homoglyph and trojan source attacks

rule: Static security analysis is enforced across all Go packages using gosec
notes: Detects hardcoded credentials, weak crypto, and file traversal vulnerabilities

rule: SQL database connections and transactions must be closed properly (sqlclosecheck)
notes: Prevents connection pool exhaustion and resource leakage in CA services

rule: All error return values must be explicitly checked without omission (errcheck)
notes: Exceptions declared explicitly for safe writers in .golangci.yml

rule: OpenTelemetry distributed tracing spans must be managed correctly using spancheck
notes: Ensures traces are ended properly across microservices

rule: Dead code, unused variables, and unused parameters are forbidden (unused, unparam)
notes: Maintains lean and auditable codebase

rule: Unit tests must pass with data race detector enabled (-race)
notes: Prevents data races in concurrent certificate issuance routines

rule: Integration tests must execute against local MariaDB database and mock HSM services
notes: Validates end-to-end ACME protocol operations in Docker environment

rule: Boulder is licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0)
notes: MPL-2.0 license required for all CA software components

rule: Pull requests require review and sign-off from Boulder core maintainers
notes: Requires passing CI and security team approval

rule: Go toolchain version is pinned and enforced in go.mod
notes: Ensures reproducible builds and consistent standard library security fixes

rule: C protocol dissector formatting must follow doc/README.developer: 4-space indent, no tabs
notes: Strict conventions for dissection code layout

rule: Banned unsafe C runtime APIs (strcpy, sprintf, unvalidated pointer arithmetic) are prohibited by checkAPIs.pl
notes: Enforces safe string and buffer operations across all dissectors

rule: Protocol dissectors must access packet data exclusively through TVB (testy virtual buffer) accessors
mechanical_form: TVB exception handling in packet processing
notes: Prevents out-of-bounds packet memory reads by throwing caught exception on truncated packets

rule: Memory allocation in packet dissection must use wmem scoped memory pools (wmem_alloc), never raw malloc
notes: Scoped packet and file pools automatically freed; prevents memory leaks

rule: All source files must contain approved GPL-compatible license headers checked by checklicenses.py
notes: Verifies SPDX / license blocks across all files

rule: Wireshark source code is licensed under the GNU General Public License v2 or later (GPL-2.0-or-later)
notes: GPL-2.0-or-later standard across core and plugins

rule: Commit message subject must describe protocol or issue; merge commits are not allowed in MRs
notes: Linear rebased commit history required

rule: Changes must be submitted as GitLab Merge Requests and reviewed by a core developer
notes: Requires manual review and passing automated CI pipelines

rule: Dissector test battery and protocol fuzzing must pass in GitLab CI
notes: Automated test suites validate packet capture dissection

rule: Continuous integration builds across Windows, macOS, and Linux with AddressSanitizer and Clang analyzer
notes: Validates memory safety and portability across platforms

rule: Dissectors must register protocol fields through proto_register_* and hf_register_info tables
notes: Enforces declarative protocol tree schemas for filter engine
